jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, AI Technology
jobs.description:
Level Up Your Career with Zynga!

At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.

From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. Fan-favorites and latest hits include FarmVille™, Words With Friends™, Zynga Poker™, Game of Thrones Slots Casino™, Wizard of Oz Slots™, Hit it Rich! Slots™, Wonka Slots™, Top Eleven™, Toon Blast™, Empires & Puzzles™, Merge Dragons!™, CSR Racing™, Harry Potter: Puzzles & Spells™, Match Factory™, and Color Block Jam™—plus many more!

Founded in 2007 and headquartered in California, our teams span North America, Europe, and Asia, working together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.

Join us and be part of the play!

Position Overview:

We're looking for a Lead Product Manager to run execution on Zynga's internal AI operating platform - the system through which teams across the company access, govern, and act on AI capabilities. This role owns the operational backbone that turns AI requests into shipped capabilities: intake, triage, research, execution with engineering, and measurement of impact.

You'll partner directly with engineering to drive delivery across a platform spanning several interconnected surfaces (chat, knowledge bases, connectors/MCPs, workflows, and documents). This is a hands-on, execution-heavy role for someone who's energized by running a tight operational loop - turning incoming requests into scoped work, keeping engineering unblocked, and holding the team accountable to outcomes with data. You'll work within a roadmap and priorities set by product leadership, and focus on making sure the right things get built, on time, and that you can prove they're working.

What You'll Do:

-
Drive day-to-day execution of the AI platform roadmap in close partnership with engineering - from spec through release and post-launch iteration.

-
Build and run the intake and triage process for incoming requests (studio needs, feature ideas, bugs, integration asks), establishing clear criteria for prioritization and a repeatable operating cadence.

-
Conduct research to support product decisions - technical landscape scans (models, tooling, competitive AI platforms), stakeholder discovery, and feasibility assessments - and turn findings into clear, actionable write-ups.

-
Own the measurement framework for the platform: usage, adoption, and performance metrics, reporting cadence, and the mechanisms to catch regressions or gaps early.

-
Write clear, detailed, and technically grounded specs and requirements for complex, cross-surface features; make day-to-day tradeoff calls when priorities, timelines, or scope conflict.

-
Act as the primary product point of contact for engineering on your area, unblocking the team and escalating the right issues to leadership.

-
Coordinate with design, other product leads, and studio stakeholders to keep execution aligned with agreed priorities.

-
Stay current on the technical AI landscape (models, agent frameworks, emerging tools) as it relates to features already in flight or under evaluation.

-
Be a role model for AI-first ways of working: actively look for pieces of your own product work - intake, triage, research, reporting - that can be moved into agentic workflows rather than done by hand, and set the example for how the rest of the team should operate.

-
Contribute to team operating practices - documentation standards, spec quality, reporting rigor - that keep execution consistent as the platform grows.

What You Bring:

- 6+ years of end-to-end PM experience, leading complex, technical, multi-team product areas from strategy through delivery.

- Deep technical fluency & engineering partnership: Able to navigate specs, APIs, and system constraints to make credible tradeoffs and earn team trust.

- AI/ML expertise: Hands-on experience with AI-powered products (LLMs, agents, RAG, automation) and using AI tools to streamline internal workflows.

- Strong operational rigor: Track record of designing structured intake/triage processes, managing competing priorities, and driving multi-workstream execution.

- Data-driven decision making: Proficient in defining metrics, analyzing data (SQL/dashboards), and using evidence to prioritize and measure impact.

- Exceptional communication: Proven ability to write clear specs and translate complex technical execution for both engineering and senior leadership.

- High agency in ambiguity: A self-starter who thrives in undefined environments, takes ownership, and shapes process rather than waiting for direction.

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience (advanced degree a plus). Agile-fluent.

What We Offer You :

Zynga offers a world-class benefits package that helps support and balance the needs of our teams. To find out more about our benefits, visit the Zynga Benefits site

The pay range for this position in Ontario at the start of employment is expected to be between $118,300 and $168,300 CAD per Year. However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations. Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards and eligibility to participate in our 401(K) plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program. Regular, full-time employees are also eligible for a range of benefits at the Company, including: medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance coverage; 14 paid holidays per calendar year; paid vacation time per calendar year (ranging from 15 to 25 days) or eligibility to participate in the Company’s discretionary time off program; up to 10 paid sick days per calendar year; paid parental and compassionate leave; wellbeing programs for mental health and other wellness support; family planning support through Maven; commuter benefits; and reimbursements for fitness-related expenses.The use of Artificial Intelligence is not being used to screen candidates. The position is for an existing vacancy.

Please note that Zynga is unable to provide visa sponsorship or assistance for this position. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without requiring current or future employer sponsorship.

About the Role

Spend more time playing collection/simulation/RPG games than sleeping? If you obsessively check leaderboards, have opinions about gacha mechanics, and get genuinely excited by a well-timed live event - we want to talk.
Join the Dragon City team as a Product Manager Intern and turn your love for games into real player insights and product impact. You'll work side by side with experienced PMs, learning how to analyse game performance, track market trends, and help shape the future of one of the world's most iconic dragon-collecting games. From digging into live-ops data to benchmarking the competition, this is your chance to see how a top free-to-play title is built, measured, and grown from the inside out.

What You'll Do

As a Product Manager Intern, you'll be right in the action, working alongside experienced PMs to:

-
Benchmark competitor collection, social and RPG games to identify trends and surface new feature ideas.

-
Gather player feedback through community research, surveys, and in-game data to improve the player experience.

-
Assist with feature and content launches: testing, monitoring, and documenting learnings.

-
Dive into game metrics - retention, monetisation, engagement, and turn data into actionable insights.

-
Support live-ops planning, dragon event scheduling, and cross-team coordination.

What We're Looking For

-
You're a current student (Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, Mathematics, Game Design, UX… or similar).

-
You're passionate about collection, social, RPG mobile games - Dragon City experience is a big plus.

-
You have strong analytical skills and are comfortable working with numbers and spreadsheets.

-
You're curious, proactive, and eager to learn about product analytics, game economy, and live-ops.

-
You're an excellent communicator in English (Spanish is a plus).

-
Bonus points if you've participated in game jams, personal projects, or uni assignments related to gaming or app design.

What’s in it for You as a Socialpointer

-
Hybrid working model – join our Barcelona office and enjoy amazing benefits:

-
Free breakfast and lunch at the office.

-
State-of-the-art gym facilities so you can level up your fitness game.

-
Book an appointment with our onsite physiotherapist.

-
Drop by our onsite hairdressers for a trim (and forget your wallet).

-
Hands-on learning from senior Product Managers.

-
Private medical insurance to keep your health bar full.

-
English and Spanish lessons to grow your skills.

-
Spotify Premium.

-
Legendary events and parties that make working here even more fun.

Intrigued? We’d love to hear from you. Please click “apply” to level up and submit your application in English.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager with experience in Ad monetization or Ad Technology systems to shape, execute & distribute our Ad Technology SDK across 50+ Games at Zynga!  This role specializes in key aspects of our product lifecycle, building customized ad formats for our games and delivering experiments, readouts and optimizations.

This role requires a blend of product management and ad monetization experience. Ideal candidates should have experience working on monetization/payments systems and should be deeply familiar with how games balance engagement with IAA/IAP monetization.

What You'll Do

- Lead experiments for our Advertising platform from experiment design through analysis and rollout -> fine-tuning supply and demand side features that impact how our players see ads, and how we price them

- Support the distribution and updates of our SDK releases across 50+ games through different studio build paths

- Execute against our product strategy customizing game-side logic on ad loading, surfacing and trigger points

- Identify problems or areas of optimization with our core ad serving logic, and design new solutions that challenge our product's status quo

- Maintain a pulse on the rapidly evolving Ad Tech landscape, including new ad formats, platform requirements, and privacy changes

- Help us develop 0-1 systems, including automating our SDK upgrades through build pipelines

- Support our live operations business lines on an ongoing basis, providing technical insight and expertise into how to fix problems and triage issues

- Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and user interviews to identify new product opportunities and improvements.

What You Bring

- Experience: 5+ years of product management experience, with a minimum of 3 years focused on Ad Technology, monetization, or similar domains in the mobile or gaming space.

- Ad Tech Knowledge: Strong understanding of the mobile advertising ecosystem, including ad mediation, ad networks, SDKs, DSPs, SSPs, ad exchanges, and programmatic advertising.

- Analytical Skills: Excellent analytical and quantitative skills; ability to use data and metrics to back up assumptions and drive product decisions. Required experience writing SQL queries to extract data and articulate your analysis

- Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to describe complex technical concepts to a non-technical audience.

- Technical Aptitude: Ability to work closely with engineering teams and discuss technical trade-offs.

- Experience working on ad technology systems either on the buy or sell side of the industry (DSP or SSP)

- Experience working on games or in the free-to-play mobile market.

- Prior experience with ad platform integrations and third-party vendor management

- B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance/Economics or a related field.

- Analyze current monetization strategy including pricing, segmentation, what value we give to users and define the right strategy for the game
